user: How does the review process work and how long does it take?
answer:
The knowledge base sets review targets by reason-code type:

- **Card reason codes:** 10 business days.
- **Transfer reason codes:** 20 business days.
- **Complex cases** involving a foreign acquirer may take up to 45 calendar days. The customer is notified if this applies.

The documents don't say which category `goods_not_received` falls under, so I can't confirm the exact timeline for TX-0401 from them. Opening the dispute would start the review clock.

Other points from the process documents:

- A customer can withdraw a dispute at any time before it is resolved. Withdrawal is final, and the same transaction cannot be disputed again under the same reason code.
- Cases move through open, under review, provisional credit, resolved upheld, or resolved declined. Only open and under-review cases can be withdrawn.

For TX-0401 (EUR 240.00), the dispute must be opened by **2026-10-18**. Would you like me to open the `goods_not_received` dispute for the full EUR 240.00? Please reply "yes" to confirm.

Dispute handling process
## Withdrawing a dispute
A customer may withdraw a dispute at any time before resolution. Withdrawal is
final; the same transaction cannot be disputed again under the same reason code.

Dispute handling process
## Review timelines
The review target is 10 business days for card reason codes and 20 business
days for transfer reason codes. Complex cases involving a foreign acquirer may
run to 45 calendar days; the customer is notified when that happens.

Dispute handling process
## Case states
A dispute moves through: open, under_review, provisional_credit,
resolved_upheld, resolved_declined. Only open and under_review cases can be
withdrawn by the customer.

Payment dispute rules
## Reason codes and chargeback windows
Each dispute reason code has its own window, counted in days from the
transaction date. A dispute opened after the window closes is not eligible.

| Reason code | Window (days) |
|---|---|
| fraud_card_not_present | 120 |
| goods_not_received | 90 |
| duplicate_charge | 60 |
| service_not_rendered | 90 |
| unauthorized_debit | 56 |
